newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-WEEKEND FIXTURES IN THE ITALIAN LEAGUE CHAMPIONSHIP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-WEEKEND FIXTURES IN THE ITALIAN LEAGUE CHAMPIONSHIP.

text.p: Matches to be played in the Italian
first division this weekend:
(league positions in parentheses; all kick-off times GMT)
Saturday
Atalanta (18) v Lazio (6) 1330
In form Lazio, 2-1 winners against Verona in a midweek Italian Cup tie, will expect to pick up at least a point against bottom of table Atlanta led by Gigi Lentini and Filippo Inzaghi.
Injury-hit Lazio are likely to play reserve goalkeeper Fernando Orsi and South African defender Mark Fish.
Sunday
Fiorentina (11) v AC Milan (2) 1330
Fiorentina will be looking for a morale-boosting win after losing to Bologna in the cup in midweek. Milan will be without Franco Baresi, Dejan Savicevic, Demetrio Albertini and Edgar Davids.
Inter-Milan (3) v Parma (6) 1330
Held to a 2-2 draw in the Italian Cup by Cagliari in midweek, Inter will hope to do better against a Parma side struggling with form and injury.
Napoli (14) v Bologna (7) 1330

The two Russian Igors, Kolivanov and Shalimov, along with Swede Kennet Andersson lead bouyant Bologna against a Napoli side featuring Argentine Roberto Ayala and Brazilians Andre Cruz, Beto and Caio. Both sides won midweek cup ties, Bologna beating Fiorentina 3-1 and Napoli beating second division Pescara 1-0.
Perugia (10) v Udinese (9) 1330

Perguia owner Luciano Gaucci keeps waiting for the side to lose in order to sack coach Giovanni Galeone. Against an Udinese team missing suspended German striker Oliver Bierhoff, he may have to wait another week.
Piacenza (12) v Verona (15) 1330
This match could provide a rare sight -- a Serie A game featuring only Italians. Piacenza have no foreigners, while Verona have only one - the Brazilian Reinaldo, due to start on the subs' bench.
Reggiana (17) v Sampdoria (8) 1330
Sampdoria, without suspended Frenchman Christian Karembeu, may prove too strong for second from bottom Reggiana, eliminated from the Italian Cup midweek by Milan.
Vicenza (4) v Cagliari (16) 1330

Third from bottom Cagliari, playing their first league game under new coach Carlo Mazzone, will look to Uruguyan Dario Silva and Roberto Muzzi in attack against a Vicenza side led by another Uruguyan Marcelo Otero.
